summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Routes International Nurse Recruitment Workflow Management System. Tested admin panel, staff dashboard, and public candidate tracker with 14-stage pipeline workflow, payment approval system, and exit validation.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 when searching by candidate name, works with passport/application ID
minor_bugs.impact: Public tracker search limited to exact passport/application ID matches

integration_issues.issue: Occasional timeout during staff login transition

passed_tests: Admin login with admin/admin credentials and subtle toggle
Admin dashboard stats and pipeline distribution display
Admin staff account creation and management
Admin payment approval system (add, approve, reject)
Admin candidate search with flowchart view
Staff candidate creation (name, passport, application ID)
Staff incoming register with document list tracking
Staff outgoing register auto-fetching incoming documents
Staff return register showing incoming/outgoing details
Staff exit register payment validation and blocking
Staff stage management with locking checkboxes
Public candidate tracker by passport/application ID
Admin panel accessibility via login toggle only
Navigation between all sections and tabs
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix public candidate tracker API to support name-based search in addition to passport/application ID search. Currently /api/public/track endpoint returns 404 when searching by candidate name.
